children.text: <d>A terminal UI that is one value. Every screen in this showcase is JSON.</>

items.title: Notes
items.blurb: A notes app: a list of notes, and a caretline editor on the one you pick. Each note is an entry in the store, so switching screens, pushing a new UI or restarting loses nothing.
items.try: Enter on the field adds a note · x deletes the selected one · Tab moves between panes · type anywhere in the editor; Ctrl-Z undoes

items.title: Ledger
items.blurb: Bookkeeping written as JSON: a table of entries with totals, a form that appends to the ledger, and a summary (balance, spending by category, the running balance) that a helper process computes from the store and streams back.
items.try: Tab to the form, fill it in, Enter on the amount · x deletes the selected entry · the summary updates on its own

items.title: Markets
items.blurb: A live feed: a helper prints prices as JSON lines and the screen redraws from them, a few times a second. The data goes from the command to the screen; it never passes through a model.
items.try: j / k move through the watchlist · the detail follows the selection

items.title: Gallery
items.blurb: Every component, every variant and every tone, under the theme you have on. Screens ask for meanings (card, quiet, warn), never colours, so one key restyles everything.
items.try: t switches theme · ←/→ switch tabs when the tab bar has focus

items.title: Agent
items.blurb: What agents did over the socket, newest first. Run examples/showcase/tour.sh in another terminal and watch an agent drive this showcase: open screens, write a note, book an entry, change the theme.
items.try: Leave this open and start the tour beside it
